name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Add a payment yourself: a new Add a payment button on the Payments tab records a payment for any customer, not only the ones who message you. You still confirm the amount and post it into Tally in one tap.
Quieter and safer: if you do not open ASVA for a few days it pauses on its own and sends nothing, then picks up where it left off when you reopen it. A customer who asks to stop stays stopped until they ask again.
Reminders now go out steadily through the day instead of in a burst, which keeps your own WhatsApp number safe.
Payments capture themselves more reliably, and a blurry or missing payment screenshot never drops a payment.
A cleaner phone app with a Chase-today view.
